node.title: L1 full-domain pullback intrinsic rigidity
node.statement: Let H=alpha*mu_n lie in a finite field, let s|n, and let P be monic of degree s. If complete s-point level fibers of P partition all of H, then multiplying their locators gives X^n-alpha^n=F(P). Hence K(X^n) is contained in K(P) inside the cyclic Galois extension K(X)/K(X^n). The unique order-s subgroup fixes K(X^s), so K(P)=K(X^s); polynomial behavior at infinity and monicity force P=X^s+c. Thus every full-domain pullback partition is the intrinsic mu_s quotient, and every fully fiberwise exact support is owned by pma_exact_periodic_owner. There is no non-intrinsic full-domain residual, including the former sub-Johnson sector. General pullback escape requires incomplete domain fibers, partial-fiber agreement, or failure to carry a whole fixed-source petal.
